name: Queer Frame
subtitle: Does she die? Lesbian TV guide
promotional_text: Does she die? You choose when to find out. 2,200+ TV shows with queer women, non-binary and trans characters: worth it or not, where to watch, next episodes. No account.
description:
Does she die? Queer Frame keeps that answer hidden until you tap, for more than 2,000 TV shows with queer women, non-binary and trans characters. Before you start a show, see whether it's worth watching, where to stream it and when the next episode airs. No account, no tracking.

Look up a show and see:
• Is it worth watching? LezWatch.TV's worth-it verdict, plus ratings for quality, realness and screen time.
• Do any queer characters die? Hidden until you tap to reveal.
• Tropes, and LezWatch.TV's trigger-warning level with what it means.
• Where to stream it.
• When the next episode airs.
• An Up Next widget and optional new-episode reminders, set on your iPhone.

Filter for shows with no recorded deaths, with a where-to-watch link, or by worth-it verdict. Favorite what you're following and see each show's next episode at a glance. Favorites stay on your iPhone.

Queer Frame bundles its data, so it works offline as soon as it's installed, and it tells you how current that data is. The data is a nightly mirror of LezWatch.TV, the volunteer-run database of queer female, non-binary and transgender characters, and of TVmaze, credited on every show and character. Where the source is silent, the app says so: "not recorded" never becomes "survives".

No account. No analytics. No ads. No third-party SDKs. The app's one network request fetches its data file.

One-time purchase. No subscription, no in-app purchases.
whats_new: Deaths now count only when they happen in that show and LezWatch.TV lists the character as dead. Each trigger-warning level is explained, About has Rate and Email support rows, and there's a new aubergine color. Show data as of November 9, 2026.
